SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-26-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF O'CONNOR, ROBERT J. RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SO, NATALIE J. $2,043.36 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,133.36, WATER LEAKS FROM DEFENDANT'S PRIVATELY INSTALLED ICEMAKER HOSE LINE ENTERED PLAINTIFF'S CONDOMINIUM AND CREATED A CONDITION THAT WAS AN OBSTRUCTION OF PLAINTIFF'S FREE USE OF HIS PROPERTY WITHOUT CONSENT. SUCH WATER INTRUSION & WATER DAMAGE INTERFERED WITH PLAINTIFF'S COMFORTABLE USE & ENJOYMENT OF HIS PROPERTY IN THE SUM AWARDED FOR HARMS CAUSED.
